run_setup_install: run the setup.py to install the mtm package with pip install in the project root directory
run_setup_sdist: run the setup.py to build a source distribution tarball using python setup.py sdist
run_setup_egg_info: run the setup.py to generate egg metadata using python setup.py egg_info
review_read_requirements_file: review the read_requirements_file function that reads a requirements file and returns a list of stripped dependency strings
refactor_read_requirements_file: refactor the read_requirements_file function to filter out empty lines and comments from the requirements file
